courses.overview: 跨單元連結與比較練習

related.title: 新加坡新生水系統
related.why: 比較兩個系統的物質或能量收支，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare material or energy balances and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 設備尺度、進料組成與品質目標必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Equipment scale, feed composition and quality objectives require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 香港渠務署說明昂船洲以氯化鐵與聚合物促進懸浮物沉降，清液經消毒後排放。
courses.summaryEn: Hong Kong DSD describes ferric chloride and polymer aiding suspended-solids settling, followed by disinfection of the clarified effluent before discharge.

history.title: 香港昂船洲污水處理廠
history.text: 香港渠務署說明昂船洲以氯化鐵與聚合物促進懸浮物沉降，清液經消毒後排放。
history.textEn: Hong Kong DSD describes ferric chloride and polymer aiding suspended-solids settling, followed by disinfection of the clarified effluent before discharge.

courses.connection: 昂船洲課程以化學強化初級處理為主，不將其誤寫成活性污泥廠；學徒比較絮凝、沉澱、污泥及後端排放的質量去向。
courses.connectionEn: This Stonecutters course focuses on chemically enhanced primary treatment rather than mislabeling it as activated sludge; the learner traces flocculation, settling, sludge and discharge.
